name: evlike
expr: nL_b = evlike([0, 1], x); nL_c = evlike([0, 1], x, cens); nL_f = evlike([0, 1], x, [], freq); nL_cf = evlike([0, 1], x, cens, freq); nL_s0 = evlike([0, 0], x); nL_sneg = evlike([0, -1], x); nL_e = evlike([0, 1], []);
comment: Sig: nL = evlike([mu sigma], x[, cens, freq]). Type-I extreme value (Gumbel min). Uncensored: log(σ) - z + e^z; censored: e^z; with optional freq weights. Edges: σ<=0 -> NaN (was Inf); empty data -> 0. AVAR (2-output form) deferred — observed Fisher info has nontrivial cross-terms.
